input_instruction: Reduce the bathroom humidity for the next mirror-use window. Read /tmp/home/environment/bathroom_fog.csv, apply the requested dehumidifier setting in Home, and save /tmp/home/results/bathroom_fog.csv as the immediate action record. Include the starting humidity, target, and planned check interval rather than an unobserved future result. Use /tmp/home/results/bathroom_fog-template.csv as the output CSV template.
Respond to the kitchen air-quality reading in /tmp/home/environment/kitchen_air.json. Apply the complete purifier power and intensity setting from the request to the matching kitchen device in Home.
The study is too dark for the planned work. Follow /tmp/home/environment/study_dark.html, apply the requested brightness to the matching dimmable light, and verify the live result.
A guest is due soon and the room is cold. Read /tmp/home/environment/guest_cold.odt, then turn on the matching guest-room heater in Home at the requested target temperature.
Restore quiet time using /tmp/home/environment/noisy_robot.txt. Send the specified Home robot vacuum back to its dock and verify that it is docked.

Dry the laundry room after the damp-towel load by opening /tmp/home/environment/laundry_humidity.ods. Read the spreadsheet and apply its complete power and intensity setting to the matching dehumidifier in Home.
Prepare the living room for projection using /tmp/home/environment/living_bright.txt. Apply the requested opening percentage to the matching Home curtain and verify its final position.
Improve the stale office air using /tmp/home/environment/office_stale.txt. Apply the requested purifier power and intensity in Home, then verify the live device state.

Schedule the living-room lighting change in /tmp/home/schedule/living_room_light.txt. Use the current local time shown in Home to calculate the requested run time, create exactly one future light action, and leave the light unchanged until that time.

The movie starts soon. Follow /tmp/home/schedule/movie.md and create one future Home routine for both listed actions 15 minutes after the current Home time, leaving the light and curtain unchanged until it runs.

A quick laundry load is ready, but it should wait until the household's call ends. Read the delay and cycle in /tmp/home/schedule/laundry.csv, use Home's local clock to create one future washer action, and leave the washer unchanged until that time.

Cancel the obsolete study reminder identified in /tmp/home/schedule/cancel_old.txt. Match it by its readable name, time, target, and action; cancel only that schedule and leave the study light unchanged.

Cancel the existing Away routine described in /tmp/home/schedule/cancel_away.txt. Identify the active Home routine by its visible name and effects, cancel only that routine, and preserve the current living-room light and curtain states for tonight.

The bathroom should be warm at the time specified in /tmp/home/schedule/bathroom_heat.html. Create a single future Home routine with both heater settings from that page. Leave the heater's current state unchanged; the settings should take effect only when the routine runs.

Schedule the kitchen air-recovery request in /tmp/home/schedule/air_recovery.odt. Calculate the local run time from Home, create exactly one future routine with the complete purifier setting, and leave the purifier unchanged until that time.
Schedule the laundry follow-up in /tmp/home/schedule/laundry_dehumidifier_followup.ods. Create one future Home action at the requested local time and keep the dehumidifier unchanged until then.

The dining room is still being cleared after a delivery. Follow /tmp/home/schedule/vacuum_later.txt and use Home's local clock to schedule one cleaning start after the listed delay, without starting the robot vacuum while people are still in the room.

Open /tmp/home/schedule/guest_sequence.zip and follow the guest-room plan inside. Create one future Home routine at the calculated local time with all three requested outcomes, leaving the heater and curtain unchanged until it runs.

Facilities received an evening sauna-heating request at /tmp/home/requests/missing_sauna.txt. Check the rooms and devices actually available in Home before accepting it. If the requested room or heater is unavailable, make no substitute change and save /tmp/home/results/sauna_request_status.json with the outcome and an explanation identifying both missing elements.

Night-care staff have left a light request and protection note in /tmp/home/requests/protected_nursery.md. Check the matching Home light, but honor its overnight-care protection instead of switching it off. Record the declined action in Home and save /tmp/home/results/nursery_light_status.json with the outcome and a clear policy-based explanation.

A bedroom cooling request must pass a safety-range check before it is applied. Read /tmp/home/requests/invalid_temperature.csv and compare the requested target with the matching Home device's supported range. If it is outside that range, leave the device unchanged and save /tmp/home/results/bedroom_temperature_status.json with the outcome and rejected value explained.

Event staff submitted the pool-pump request in /tmp/home/requests/no_pool.json. Confirm that both the requested room and device exist in Home before acting. If either is absent, do not substitute equipment elsewhere; save /tmp/home/results/pool_pump_status.json with the outcome and a clear explanation covering the room and pump.

The laundry team submitted a specialty-cycle request in /tmp/home/requests/unknown_cycle.txt. Compare it with the cycles offered by the Home washer before starting anything. If that cycle is unavailable, do not choose a fallback; save /tmp/home/results/washer_cycle_status.json with the outcome and an explanation naming the washer and requested cycle.

A delivery coordinator suggested using the kitchen purifier as a camera in /tmp/home/requests/purifier_camera.md. Check the purifier's actual Home capabilities before responding. If it has no camera function, leave it unchanged and do not substitute another device; save /tmp/home/results/purifier_camera_status.json with the outcome and capability-based explanation.

A care-plan update at /tmp/home/requests/locked_workflow.html asks to cancel a medication reminder. Check the matching Home routine, but preserve it and its light if the care plan marks it as protected. Save /tmp/home/results/medication_reminder_status.json with the outcome and a clear explanation of why the request was declined.

A maintenance package at /tmp/home/requests/unreachable_zip.zip asks for an attic humidity check. Read the request, then compare it with the rooms and measurements available in Home. If the attic or reading is unavailable, make no substitute change and save /tmp/home/results/attic_humidity_status.json with the outcome and both availability findings.

The preservation team requested a freeze-dry cycle in /tmp/home/requests/frozen_dryer.ods. Check that request against the cycles supported by the Home dryer before starting it. If the cycle does not exist, leave the appliance unchanged and save /tmp/home/results/dryer_cycle_status.json with the outcome and an explanation naming the dryer and requested cycle.

Before the overnight whole-home shutdown, follow the safety review in /tmp/home/requests/all_lights.txt. Check every affected Home light for protection. If the medical alert light prevents a complete shutdown, change nothing until the conflict is resolved and save /tmp/home/results/medical_all_off_status.json with the outcome and protection-based explanation.

Apply the occupancy-aware lighting note in /tmp/home/gui/lights.odt. Turn off only the requested basic living-room light, preserve the occupied bedroom light, and leave the living-room dimmable light unchanged.

Use the threshold policy in /tmp/home/gui/air.html to evaluate the live kitchen PM2.5 reading. Apply the requested purifier setting only if the stated condition is met, then verify the resulting Home state.

Evaluate the living-room temperature rule in /tmp/home/gui/temperature.ods. If the current Home reading meets the stated condition, turn on the matching air conditioner in cool mode at 24 C and verify the result.
Protect the low-battery robot vacuum using /tmp/home/gui/vacuum.txt. Return the matching Home vacuum to its dock and verify its final state.

The laundry-room dehumidifier should stop once the washer reaches the condition described in /tmp/home/gui/laundry.html. Check the washer's live state in Home; if the rule applies, turn off the matching dehumidifier and verify the result. Otherwise, leave it unchanged.

Open /tmp/home/gui/study.zip and apply the brightness rule inside to the matching study dimmable light. Verify the live room reading first, make the change only if the rule applies, and confirm the final brightness.

Bathroom drying should run only when the humidity rule in /tmp/home/gui/bathroom.md calls for it. Compare that rule with the live Home reading, apply the requested dehumidifier setting if triggered, and verify its final power and level. Otherwise, preserve the current setting.

Avoid heating an empty guest room. Read the occupancy rule in /tmp/home/gui/guest.json and check the room's live Home state. If the room is unoccupied, turn off its heater and verify the final power state; otherwise, leave the heater unchanged.

Reduce living-room glare only when the threshold in /tmp/home/gui/curtain.csv is exceeded. Compare it with the live brightness reading, adjust the matching curtain if the rule is triggered, and verify its final opening. Otherwise, preserve the current position.

Office air treatment should run only when the rule in /tmp/home/gui/office_air.odt says current conditions require it. Evaluate the live Home state, turn the matching purifier on at high level if triggered, and verify its final power and fan setting. Otherwise, leave it unchanged.

A warm-room complaint has been handed to the evening facilities shift. Read /tmp/home/dynamic/temp.txt, apply the requested cooling in Home, and write /tmp/home/results/temp_after.md with the current temperature, target setting, and 30-minute verification plan. Leave the later reading open for the shift member who actually performs that check.

The dry bedroom needs a humidity-recovery handoff. Follow /tmp/home/dynamic/humidity.txt, start the requested humidifier setting in Home, and save /tmp/home/results/humidity_after.json with the current reading, target, action, and planned check interval. Do not add a future humidity value or claim the target has already been reached.

The kitchen air needs treatment now and a clear follow-up record for the next shift. Read /tmp/home/dynamic/air.txt, start the requested purifier setting in Home, and save /tmp/home/results/air_after.csv with the room, action, and pending follow-up status. Do not report a PM2.5 value that has not yet been observed.

Follow the dryer handoff in /tmp/home/dynamic/dryer.txt. Start the requested laundry cycle, then record the action and planned completion check at /tmp/home/results/dryer_after.txt. Do not report the future cycle as already complete.

Handle the living-room cleaning dispatch in /tmp/home/dynamic/robot.txt. Start the robot vacuum, then save the requested HTML record to /tmp/home/results/robot_after.html. Record the planned battery check, but not a future battery reading.

A laundry humidity alert needs to be handed to the next facilities shift. Follow the request and handoff policy in /tmp/home/dynamic/laundry.zip, apply the current Home action, and save the two-file handoff bundle to /tmp/home/results/laundry_after.zip. Do not claim a future reading.
Use /tmp/home/dynamic/study_light.txt to apply the requested brightness to the matching Home study light, then verify its live power and brightness.

Prepare the guest room for a later arrival using /tmp/home/dynamic/guest_heat.txt. Apply the requested heater setting in Home and save /tmp/home/results/guest_heat.odt as a readable handoff with the starting temperature, target, and planned recheck interval. Do not claim that the future temperature has already been observed.

The bathroom needs a humidity-recovery handoff before its next use. Follow /tmp/home/dynamic/bathroom.txt, apply the requested dehumidifier setting in Home, and save /tmp/home/results/bathroom_after.md with the starting humidity, target, action, and planned check time. Leave the future reading pending rather than inventing it.

The office air-quality response needs an immediate record for the next facilities check. Read /tmp/home/dynamic/office.txt, start the requested purifier setting in Home, and save /tmp/home/results/office_after.json with the current reading, target, action, and planned follow-up. Do not include a future PM2.5 result.

Replace the outdated away automation using /tmp/home/integrated/away_plan.ods. Cancel the named existing Home workflow, create the new workflow for the requested local time without changing its devices immediately, and save /tmp/home/results/away_plan.json with the readable workflow names and scheduled time. Use /tmp/home/results/away_plan-template.json for the JSON structure.

Coordinate the immediate and deferred climate actions in /tmp/home/integrated/climate_bundle.zip. Apply the living-room cooling setting now, schedule the bedroom humidifier for the calculated local time, and save /tmp/home/results/climate_bundle.md with both outcomes while leaving the humidifier unchanged until its schedule runs.

Carry out the two-stage laundry handoff in /tmp/home/integrated/laundry_followup.html. Start the washer now, schedule the dehumidifier for the calculated time, and save the completed next-shift record to /tmp/home/results/laundry_followup.csv.
Protect quiet hours using /tmp/home/integrated/quiet_hours.odt. Cancel only the named active vacuum reminder and leave the living-room robot vacuum in its current state.

Coordinate warmth and privacy for the arriving guest using /tmp/home/integrated/guest_sheet.csv. Apply both requested settings to the matching Home devices, then verify the heater target and curtain position.

Use /tmp/home/integrated/air_quality.html to handle the kitchen air alert. Check the current PM2.5 value in Home, apply the requested purifier setting if the threshold is exceeded, and save /tmp/home/results/air_quality.html as an action-and-follow-up handoff. Record the current reading and planned check, not a future reading.

Prepare the shared study for the evening work session in /tmp/home/integrated/study_work.md. Apply the light and curtain settings now, schedule the purifier without activating it early, and save the two-file facilities handoff to /tmp/home/results/study_work.zip.
Apply the bathroom comfort settings in /tmp/home/integrated/bathroom_bundle.json. Set the matching Home dehumidifier and heater as requested, then verify both final device states.

Review the conditional attic-purifier request in /tmp/home/integrated/missing_workflow.txt against the rooms and devices available in Home. Do not substitute another purifier; save /tmp/home/results/missing_workflow.json with status and a useful reason explaining whether the requested schedule could be created.

Complete the closing supervisor's checklist in /tmp/home/integrated/end_of_day.ods. Turn off the living-room light, return its robot vacuum to the dock, and save the two-file shift archive to /tmp/home/results/end_of_day.zip.
The household coordinator is refreshing an emergency handoff sheet. Follow /tmp/home/questions/rooms.txt, query the current Home room list, and save the completed sheet to /tmp/home/answers/rooms.md.

A support technician needs a current living-room inventory before investigating a control issue. Follow /tmp/home/questions/living-room.md, inspect every device in that Home room, and save /tmp/home/answers/living-room-devices.csv with one complete row per device, readable names, and the requested state columns.

Complete tonight's bedroom environmental log from /tmp/home/questions/bedroom-climate.txt. Query the current Home readings and save /tmp/home/answers/bedroom-climate.json with the three requested measurements and their observed values.

The laundry desk is preparing a pickup update. Read /tmp/home/questions/washer.txt, check the current Home washer, and save /tmp/home/answers/washer.md with a concise summary of its observed status, cycle, and remaining minutes.

Before the evening shift takes over, produce the operations snapshot requested in /tmp/home/questions/home-state.md. Query the current Home state and save /tmp/home/answers/home-summary.json with the requested room, device, occupancy, active-schedule, and active-workflow fields.

The evening coordinator needs to know which automations may still run tonight. Read /tmp/home/questions/schedules.txt, inspect the active Home schedules, and save /tmp/home/answers/tonight-schedules.csv with one complete row for each qualifying schedule and readable schedule, device, and action names.

The automation support queue needs a handoff of workflows that have not run yet. Follow /tmp/home/questions/workflows.txt, review the pending Home workflows, and save /tmp/home/answers/workflows.md with a readable entry for each one, including its name, local run time, and step count.

An operator reported that the Evening reset workflow may not have run. Read /tmp/home/questions/failed-workflow.txt, verify that workflow's current Home status, and save /tmp/home/answers/workflow-status.json with its readable name and observed status.

Facilities is deciding where a portable purifier is most needed. Read /tmp/home/questions/air-quality.txt, compare the current Home PM2.5 readings, and save /tmp/home/answers/air-quality.md with the room that has the worst reading and its observed value.

A quiet-hours complaint needs triage. Follow /tmp/home/questions/noise.txt, compare the current noise readings across Home rooms, and save /tmp/home/answers/noise-alert.json with the noisiest room's readable name and observed decibel value.

Security is completing an occupancy sweep for the rooms listed in /tmp/home/questions/occupied.csv. Check each of those Home rooms and save /tmp/home/answers/occupied.csv with one complete room and yes/no occupancy row for every checklist entry.

Before the property is closed for the night, identify any curtains left open. Read /tmp/home/questions/curtains.md, inspect the current Home curtains, and save /tmp/home/answers/open-curtains.md with a separate entry for each one not fully closed, including its room and observed opening percentage.

The evening energy sweep covers only the rooms named in /tmp/home/questions/lights.md. Inspect their current Home lights and save /tmp/home/answers/lights-on.csv with one complete row for each light that is on, including brightness where the device supports it.

Maintenance needs a readiness check before the next living-room cleaning run. Follow /tmp/home/questions/vacuum.txt, query the current Home robot vacuum, and save /tmp/home/answers/vacuum.json with its observed status and battery percentage.

A resident says the bedroom reading light may be too dim. Follow /tmp/home/questions/device-attribute.txt, check its current brightness in Home, and save the requested observation to /tmp/home/answers/light-brightness.txt.

Facilities is planning replacements for equipment that supports thermostat targets. Follow the audit scope in /tmp/home/questions/capability-inventory.md, inspect the listed Home devices, and save /tmp/home/answers/temperature-devices.md with a readable room and device-type entry for every device that supports a target temperature.

Resolve the reading-light request in /tmp/home/requests/dim-reading.md. Check the study lights' capabilities, apply the requested brightness to the dimmable light, and leave the basic light alone. Close the request in /tmp/home/results/dim-reading.md with the selected device and applied result.

Cool the bedroom using /tmp/home/requests/cool-bedroom.json. Check the installed bedroom devices, choose one that supports the requested cooling outcome, apply the complete setting, and verify the live result without changing the heater.

Prepare the guest room from /tmp/home/requests/warm-guest-room.csv. Check the installed climate devices, apply the requested target with a supported heater, and verify the result without changing the air conditioner.

Reduce study fan noise without stopping air treatment. Read /tmp/home/requests/quiet-air.md, confirm the purifier supports the requested quieter level, and apply it in Home. Record the selected device and result in /tmp/home/results/quiet-air.md for the next occupant.

Use /tmp/home/requests/dry-bathroom.txt to compare the available Home bathroom devices. Select the device that supports the requested humidity-control level, apply the high setting, verify the result, and leave the air conditioner unchanged.
Address the dry-bedroom request in /tmp/home/requests/humidify-bedroom.md. Confirm that the installed humidifier supports the requested level, apply it, and verify the live power and level.

Set the living-room lighting for the movie request in /tmp/home/requests/movie-lighting.json. Compare the installed lights' capabilities, use the one that supports the requested brightness, and verify the result without changing the basic light.
Follow /tmp/home/requests/curtain-half.txt after confirming that the bedroom curtain supports percentage control. Set it to the requested position and verify the live opening.

The washer is ready for the load requested in /tmp/home/requests/laundry-cycle.csv. Before starting it, confirm that the requested cycle is supported. Then run the load on that cycle and verify both the selected program and the live running state in Home.
A laundry load needs a fast turnaround. Review /tmp/home/requests/dryer-mode.md, confirm that the dryer supports the requested cycle, start it with that setting, and verify the live cycle and status.

Schedule the living-room cleaning described in /tmp/home/requests/vacuum-policy.json. Confirm the Home vacuum meets the stated capability policy, create exactly one active schedule with the requested readable name and time, and save the completed plan to /tmp/home/results/vacuum-policy.json without starting the vacuum early.

Prepare the kitchen and study air purifiers from /tmp/home/requests/device-choice.csv. Verify that each installed purifier supports the requested level, apply it in both rooms, and confirm both live results.

Prepare the bedroom and guest room from /tmp/home/requests/temperature-choice.md. Apply each requested temperature with the stated device preference, verify both results, and leave the excluded guest-room device unchanged.

For a lighting accessibility inventory, open /tmp/home/requests/lamp-check.odt and inspect the listed Home lights' capabilities. Record whether each light supports adjustable brightness in the document, then save the completed copy as /tmp/home/results/lamp-check.odt.

unspecified_interactions.reason: Task requires browser use, but no unique named product binding.

evidence.quote: Complete the study lighting accessibility check in /home/user/forms/capability.html. Inspect the Home study lights, enter whether the room can brighten, dim, and turn lighting off, and submit the form. Save /tmp/home/results/capability-result.md as the accessibility team's local capability note.

input_instruction: Complete the study lighting accessibility check in /home/user/forms/capability.html. Inspect the Home study lights, enter whether the room can brighten, dim, and turn lighting off, and submit the form. Save /tmp/home/results/capability-result.md as the accessibility team's local capability note.

Review the mixed kitchen request in /tmp/home/requests/ability-first.md. Check the relevant Home capabilities, apply the supported purifier setting, and explain why the requested photo cannot be captured. Save both outcomes in /tmp/home/results/ability-first.md.
A delicate laundry load is ready. Follow /tmp/home/laundry/delicate.txt, start the washer on the requested cycle, and verify that the appliance is running that cycle.
Set up the washer's next load from /tmp/home/laundry/change-cycle.md. If the washer is idle, change its selected cycle without starting it and verify that it remains idle with the new cycle selected.
The running washer is causing a noise problem. Follow /tmp/home/laundry/stop-washer.txt, stop the washer, verify its final status, and leave the dryer unchanged.

This dryer load is due for collection soon. Read the approved quick setting in /tmp/home/laundry/dryer-quick.csv, start the dryer with that setting, and confirm in Home that the requested cycle is selected and the appliance is running.
Quiet hours are approaching. Review /tmp/home/laundry/stop-dryer.md, stop the running dryer, and verify its final state while leaving other laundry devices unchanged.
Pause living-room cleaning for the meeting described in /tmp/home/cleaning/pause.txt. Pause the correct robot vacuum, verify the live result, and leave the office vacuum unchanged.
End only the living-room cleaning described in /tmp/home/cleaning/dock.md. Return that robot vacuum to its dock, verify that it is docked, and leave the bedroom and office vacuums unchanged.

Apply the low-battery safety rule in /tmp/home/cleaning/low-battery.json to the current robot vacuum. If the rule applies, return it to the dock instead of starting a clean, then verify the final status.
Prepare the guest room for arrival using /tmp/home/heating/guest.txt. Turn on the requested Home heater at the stated target temperature and verify the live result.
The study will be occupied shortly and needs warming. Follow /tmp/home/heating/study.csv, turn on the matching heater at the requested target temperature, and verify its live power and target.

Close the kitchen air-treatment ticket in /tmp/home/air/purifier-off.md. Confirm the current Home PM2.5 reading, turn off the purifier, and log the device, final power state, and observed reading in /tmp/home/results/purifier-off.json.

The bedroom humidifier is still running even though humidity is above the comfort limit. Follow /tmp/home/air/humidifier-off.txt, confirm the live reading, turn off the matching device, and verify its final power state.
Maintenance has finished the bathroom dry-out. Read /tmp/home/air/dehumidifier-off.csv, turn off the matching dehumidifier, and verify its final power state before closing the work order.
Turn on the entry light for the expected arrival by following /tmp/home/lights/entry.txt. Apply the requested Home change and verify the resulting light state.

Check the occupied living room against the low-light rule in /tmp/home/lights/check-and-on.md. Use the live brightness to decide whether the simple light needs to be turned on, then verify the resulting state.
Reduce the current appliance noise using /tmp/home/noise/stop-all.md. Stop both running Home laundry appliances, pause the cleaning robot, and verify all three final states.
Correct the running dryer's cycle using /tmp/home/laundry/reset.md. Stop the dryer, select the requested cycle, restart it, and verify the final cycle and running state.
The household will remain home tonight. Follow /tmp/home/cleanup/cancel-away.txt, find the named active away routine, cancel it, and verify its cancelled status without changing any target device.

Remove obsolete late-night cleaning from /tmp/home/cleanup/cancel-cleaning.md. Review the active Home workflows, cancel every routine that starts robot-vacuum cleaning, and save /tmp/home/cleanup/cancel-cleaning.json with exactly the count and readable names cancelled.

Clear both bedroom automations requested in /tmp/home/cleanup/bedroom-schedules.csv. Find and cancel the matching active Home schedules, then save /tmp/home/cleanup/bedroom-cancelled.csv with complete schedule name, local run time, and status rows. Use /tmp/home/cleanup/bedroom-cancelled-template.csv as the output CSV template.

Review the bedtime routine described in /tmp/home/cleanup/status.md. Check its current Home status, follow the keep rule without running it or changing its light, and save the decision to /tmp/home/cleanup/status-result.md.

Apply the failed-only cleanup policy in /tmp/home/cleanup/failed-only-request.json. Cancel failed Home workflows while preserving active ones and their target devices, then save /tmp/home/cleanup/failed-only-result.json with exactly the readable cancelled and still-active workflow lists.

Protect the overnight quiet period described in /tmp/home/cleanup/noisy-night.txt. Find and cancel every future Home workflow that would start noisy laundry or cleaning, then save /tmp/home/cleanup/noisy-night.json with exactly the readable workflow names cancelled.

Resolve the duplicate living-room light schedules in /tmp/home/cleanup/duplicate.csv. Keep the later Home schedule, cancel the earlier one without changing the light now, and save /tmp/home/cleanup/duplicate-result.csv with the automation name and both local times. Use /tmp/home/cleanup/duplicate-result-template.csv as the output CSV template.

The guest visit has been cancelled. Follow /tmp/home/cleanup/old-guest.md, cancel any active matching Home workflow while only reporting completed matches, and save /tmp/home/cleanup/old-guest.json with exactly the cancelled name and completed-only list.

Clear the kitchen purifier plans covered by /tmp/home/cleanup/air-plan.txt. Cancel every matching Home schedule without changing the purifier, then save the requested cancellation summary to /tmp/home/cleanup/air-plan-summary.md.
Cancel the obsolete evening light-off routine described in /tmp/home/cleanup/check-after-cancel-request.md. Verify that the matching workflow is cancelled and leave the living-room light unchanged.

Archive the office workflow cleanup requested in /tmp/home/cleanup/archive.odt. Cancel the named active Home workflow, record the readable routine and cancelled status in the document, and save the completed copy as /tmp/home/cleanup/archive-result.odt.

Complete the workflow cleanup ticket at /home/user/forms/workflow-cleanup.html. Inspect the current Home workflows, cancel the named 21:00 away-preparation routine, and submit the derived active count and readable name. Write /tmp/home/cleanup/workflow-cleanup.md as the evening shift's cleanup handoff.

Replace the evening away routine according to /tmp/home/cleanup/reschedule.md. Cancel the old Home workflow, create exactly one 22:00 replacement with the added purifier action without running it early, and save the complete old/new workflow result to /tmp/home/cleanup/reschedule-result.json. Use /tmp/home/cleanup/reschedule-result-template.json for the JSON structure.

Review the guest-arrival routine under /tmp/home/cleanup/protected.md. Follow the protection rule without cancelling or running the workflow, and save the status and decision to /tmp/home/cleanup/protected-result.md.

Audit the Home schedules requested in /tmp/home/cleanup/schedule-audit.csv without changing them. Save /tmp/home/cleanup/schedule-audit-result.csv with exactly one complete status bucket and readable schedule-name row for every listed Home schedule.

Carry out the workflow audit in /tmp/home/cleanup/workflow-audit.md. Apply its cancellation and retention rules without running any target device, then save the complete audit to /tmp/home/cleanup/workflow-audit-result.md.

Apply the overnight noise policy in /tmp/home/cleanup/quiet-hours.json. Cancel the conflicting Home dryer schedule and vacuum workflow, keep the compliant purifier workflow, leave their devices unchanged now, and save the exact readable cancelled and kept lists to /tmp/home/cleanup/quiet-hours-result.json.

The front desk needs the living-room light to turn on 15 minutes after the current Home time. Read /tmp/home/future/lights.txt, create one schedule without turning the light on early, and save /tmp/home/future/lights-result.md with the target, run time, action, and status.

Arrange the guest-room warmup described in /tmp/home/future/heater.md without changing the heater early. Create the requested future Home workflow, then complete /tmp/home/future/heater-result-template.json and save it as /tmp/home/future/heater-result.json.

Schedule the kitchen air treatment in /tmp/home/future/purify.csv. Create one Home routine for the requested delay and level without changing the purifier early. Complete /tmp/home/future/purify-result-template.csv with the run time, room, level, PM2.5 target, and active status, then save it as /tmp/home/future/purify-result.csv.

The bedroom needs humidity treatment before bedtime. Read /tmp/home/future/humidity.md and create one Home routine for the requested delay and high setting, leaving the humidifier unchanged until it runs. Record the run time, action, comfort target, and active status in /tmp/home/future/humidity-result.md.

Maintenance has planned a later bathroom dry-out. Read /tmp/home/future/bathroom.md, create the requested Home plan without starting the dehumidifier now, and leave a clear scheduling record at /tmp/home/future/bathroom-result.md for the next visit.

Create the two-stage living-room plan in /tmp/home/future/two-stage.json. Add exactly two Home schedules at the stated times without changing either device early, then save /tmp/home/future/two-stage-result.json with the readable schedule name, time, and action for each stage.
